summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026, announcing that management will present at the ThinkEquity Conference on October 15, 2026, at the Mandarin Oriental, New York, with CEO Sharon Carmel and CFO Danny Sandler speaking from 10:00-10:30 AM and holding select one-on-one investor meetings. The release reiterates fiscal 2026 revenue growth guidance of approximately 50% over fiscal 2025 and cites AV-market progress, Intempora RTMaps availability, VAST Cosmos Partnership, and a three-year streaming license renewal. No transaction, securities offering, or special-situation event is present; the filing is a routine investor-relations and conference announcement.
